scenes.caption: Sui Money: native-USDC spending and forward budgeting on Sui Mainnet. Tatum supplies wallet facts; Walrus remembers confirmed context.
This is the clearly labelled fictional demo, fixed at 28 October. 1,240.50 USDC minus 462 in commitments and a 180 reserve leaves 598.50. SUI stays separate.
Activity keeps wallet facts separate from explanations. A 40-USDC shared expense and a 15-USDC reimbursement give net spending of 25. These displayed payments are synthetic.

The comparison uses identical fictional balances, dates and explicit bills. Selected remembered obligations account for a 134-USDC difference. This is a replay, not a genuine personal learning session.
Plan counts only USDC already held. Expected income is excluded until settled. Recurring suggestions require confirmation; this public demo cannot save or move funds.
The proof is real and separate: Tatum verified public incoming/outgoing native-USDC transfers; 24 approved synthetic memories were stored and signed-recall verified on Walrus Mainnet.
Personal access is gated. Slush reported a security warning; do not bypass it. Atomic balance consistency and genuine cross-session learning remain release gates.
